views.label: One config, four workspaces
views.note: handoff emits one replicator group per workspace -- not one shared run.

views.label: Replicator fleet
views.note: Each workspace's replicator run is independently concurrency-capped; workspaces do not share a worker pool.

views.label: Gate before any workspace cuts over
views.note: Reconciliation runs per workspace -- a clean 3-of-4 does not clear the 4th to cut over.

cards.title: One config, four handoffs
items: handoff emits a separate replicator group + environments.yaml per workspace
Catalog scope per workspace comes from migration.yaml, not a manual split
A workspace added later is one more generated group, not a new plan

cards.title: Workspaces don't share a worker pool
items: Each workspace's replicator run has its own concurrency.max_workers (default 8)
Catalogs within one workspace still replicate sequentially -- concurrency is workspace-level, not catalog-level
4 workspaces in parallel is 4 independent runs, not 4x the per-run throughput

cards.title: Reconciliation gates per workspace
items: A clean reconcile on 3 of 4 workspaces does not clear the 4th
Cutover is scheduled per workspace against its own reconcile result
See validation/data-reconciliation for what each check covers
